gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads contemporary and neutral, its mean line set high and its curves left open at the ends. And Joystix, bold and arcade-minded with wide tracking, leaves the line-after-line reading to it.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-cham: Bold arcade lettering from Joystix, widely tracked and sturdy, heads the pair. Noto Sans Cham counters with rounded, tall lowercase forms and generous entry into every c, keeping text inviting.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-chorasmi: Loud arcade lettering from Joystix, widely tracked, with sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones. But the real draw is the large x-height of Noto Sans Chorasmian, topped by short ascenders.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-cuneifor: Joystix keeps stems and arms nearly equal in strength, widely tracked. Noto Sans Cuneiform brings an e that opens up and lowercase swollen like glass beads, a gentle foil to all that arcade boldness.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Bold arcade lettering from Joystix leans on crossbars a little slimmer than its vertical stems. But Noto Sans Elymaic wins the pairing with open apertures and ascenders that barely clear the x-height.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Joystix tracks its letters widely, with a modest, readable weight shift across every curve. Yet Noto Sans Hebrew holds the pair together with a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-imperial: Joystix shifts its stroke weight noticeably but never dramatically, in bold, wide-set arcade letters. Noto Sans Imperial Aramaic then wins on approachability, its c ends pointing apart like open pincers.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Joystix is all compact arcade swagger, bold and widely tracked, with moderate stroke contrast. Then Noto Sans Lydian steps in with capitals barely taller than lowercase, giving the loud heading a mild, approachable partner.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-mandaic: Professional in tone, Noto Sans Mandaic lets its lowercase rise close to the capitals and its curves feel unclamped. Joystix, meanwhile, supplies the bold arcade punch.
gen-dafont-joystix-gf-noto-sans-nag-mund: Calm, gently ebbing stroke thickness gives Joystix its bold arcade character, all in widely tracked lettering. Noto Sans Nag Mundari supplies lowercase that rivals the capitals.
